notes.title: Can You Save the Day? This Witch's Cat Is a Major Chaos Magnet!
notes.content:
When you play [b]Befuddle[/b], you’ll be guided by the enchanting host, B!

Not your average teenager, B is a witch whose intentions were grander than the spells she cast. Her eclectic collection of films, games and books suddenly found itself entangled in some magic that didn’t quite go to plan. Now she needs your wit and wisdom to solve the puzzles and calm the chaos. That’s the story of Befuddle and B is here to help you through the game, telling you how to play and offering her words of encouragement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43207840/bfb154c18f1a221b7bada1228f6f6fde8ec40fdb.png[/img]

In building the story behind Befuddle, we wanted a main character that stands out from the crowd. B is a modern day witch with a love for retro media. Her home is a haven of nostalgia, adorned with arcade relics and classic computers. As you play each round, the ‘befuddled’ titles appear on the screens and machines that fill B’s room.

B is a powerful witch with a kind personality, following in the footsteps of other magical heroes like Sabrina and Wanda. She has a love of horticulture too, evidenced by her impressive houseplants. Unfortunately the spell also transformed her beloved venus flytrap, but solving the befuddles should restore it back to its normal state.

A witch's tale is incomplete without a feline companion. It was actually the antics of her cat that caused all the chaos after stumbling into B’s magic circle.

We haven’t come up with a name for the cat yet, so if you have any ideas let us know in the comments. What is a solid name for a witch's cat?

- Martijn and the Snap Finger Click team
